1x power supply

products.name: Ambition Storm Wand Wireless Tattoo Machine Pen
products.description:
Once you go wireless,you will love Ambition tattoo machine. Experience the freedom of going wireless by turning your favorite tattoo machine into a wireless machine.
Material: space aluminium alloy
Needle Stroke: 4.0mm
Motor: custom Coreless Motor. Ambition Coreless motor is good with lining, shading, color packing, lettering, traditional, neotraditional.
Motor Speed: 10V - 9000RPM
Battery Capacity: 1950mAh, biult-in 3x 650mAh lithium battery
Charging time: 1.5-2 hours
Operation time: Under normal 8V voltage, the voltage stable state can last for more than 6 hours,long time working the voltage is stable.
Output fixed current：2A
Working voltage: 3.7V
Output Voltage : 5V-12V
LED display content: output voltage range + battery usage + working time
Instructions for use:
- Power ON/OFF: Long press "O" key for 3 seconds
- Output pause / resume: Short press "O" key to pause the output, and short press it again to resume the output(the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).
- Adjust output voltage: Press the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. The voltage can be adjusted through button (+) and (-) respectively with the voltage of 0.5V on each press.
- Working time: The working time can be accurate to minutes. When the power is turned off, the time will be cleared. When the output is paused, it will also stop counting.


(Single Battery)Package Included: Ambition tattoo machine includes 1pc wireless tattoo machine, 1pc RCA adapter, 1pc extra 4.0mm stroke cam, 1pc power cable, 1pc zipper box.

(Dual Battery)Package Included: Ambition tattoo machine includes 1pc wireless tattoo machine, 1pc extra battery, 1pc RCA adapter, 1pc extra 4.0mm stroke cam, 1pc power cable, 1pc zipper box.
products.short_description:
• Material: Ambition rotary tattoo machine made of aluminium alloy frame and CNC carved. Detachable as a whole, easy to disassemble, Easy to maintain and replace parts. The 30mm/1.18inches grip diameter tattoo battery pen single weight is 205g/0.45lb, length: 145mm/5.7inches.
  • Big Capacity: The single battery capacity of this cordless tattoo machine is 1950mAh. It only takes about 2 hours to fully charge. It can work continuously for 6-8 hours after fully charged. The side of the battery has a visible LCD display, which can clearly display the output voltage range, battery usage and working time. Press the voltage adjustment buttons, 5V-12V adjustable voltage,the adjustment interval is ±0.5 V.
  • About Motor: The tattoo pen built-in Coreless Motor , 10V - 9000RPM. 4.0MM stroke is good for demanding lining and color packing. Our pen machine use a direct drive system that more powerful,low vibration.This pen style tattoo machine is perfect for fine or bold lines, realistic color, new school and old school style.
  • Widely Applications: The pen machine is compatible with all cartridge needles types, direct ​derive system make tattoo machine get stronger and better for liner and shader.

--Compatible with ALL cartridge system machines and grips.


1. membrane inside system.

2. Light clear colors tip body - better visibility.

4. Smooth edges eliminate additional trauma.

--Compatible with ALL cheyenne types cartridge system machines and grips.

--100% EO Gas Sterilized and individually packaged.

--Needles made of 316 medical grade stainless steel.

products.description:
Instructions for use:

- Power ON/OFF: Long touch "O" key for 3 seconds

- Output pause / resume: Short touch "O" key to pause the output, and short touch it again to resume the output(the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).

- Adjust output voltage: Touch the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. The voltage can be adjusted through button (+) and (-) respectively with the voltage of 0.1V on each touch.

- Working time: The working time can be accurate to seconds. When the power is turned off, the time will be cleared. When the output is paused, it will also stop counting.

Power: The LED display will show the remaining power. Fast charging through the matching fast-charging Type-C data cable can usually be fully charged about 3 hours.

Please pay attention to the change of power at any time to prevent sudden power loss from affecting your tattooing work.

Tips: Our products are 100% brand new. There is a protective film on the screen. There may be a small amount of scratches during the production, packaging and transportation. Just tear off the protective film after receiving the machine.

2400mAh Large Battery Capacity

 

  1. The real capacity of the vibe battery is 2400 mAh. After many tests, a fully charged battery can work for more than 7 hours at an output voltage of 8V, and the two batteries can be used for more than 14 hours in total.
  2. The battery can be fully charged about 3 hours with the Type-C fast charging cable. And the battery is equipped with a 10V jumpstart start function, even big mags can be pushed.

 

 

High-sensitivity Touch Buttons

 

  1. The battery of the vibe tattoo machine adopts high-sensitivity touch buttons, which changes the button method of the traditional wireless battery pen. It only needs to gently place your finger on the button.
  2. High-sensitivity touch buttons can be used even if you wear tattoo gloves or the machine is covered with a machine cover bag.

 

 

Multifunction LED Display

 

  1. The vibe cordless gun machine adopts LED digital display screen, which is equipped with various machine data. It displays the machine's working voltage, current, remaining power, Hertz and timer. These data can help tattoo artists to clearly know the working status of the machine and meet daily tattooing needs.
  2. The ambition vibe machine displays your machine speed in both Hertz & Volts. When you adjust the volt, the hertz will be changed too. Hertz allows you to know the current speed of your machine more precisely. The working voltage of the vibe machine is 4.5V-12V, the frequency of 4.5V working voltage is about 72 Hz, and the frequency of 12V is about 196 Hz. Its frequency will change with voltage regulation, adjust power by 0.1.

 

 

Brushless Motor

 

  1. The vibe wireless tattoo machine built-in a brushless motor and 4.0mm stainless steel stroke cam. The brushless motor greatly prolongs the service life of the machine, and is more powerful and quieter than the coreless motor.
  2. The 4.0 stainless steel stroke cam is not easy to wear and deform, it makes the machine have good balance between lines and shading, and perfect for demanding lining and color packing.

Battery Buttons: The battery of the vibe tattoo machine adopts high-sensitivity touch buttons, which changes the button method of the traditional wireless battery pen. It only needs to gently place your finger on the button. High-sensitivity touch buttons can be used even if you wear tattoo gloves or the machine is covered with a machine cover bag.

Battery Display:The vibe cordless gun machine adopts LED digital display screen, which is equipped with various machine data. It displays the machine's working voltage, current, remaining power, Hertz and timer. These data can help tattoo artists to clearly know the working status of the machine and meet daily tattooing needs.

Battery Capacity: The real capacity of the vibe battery is 2400 mAh. After many tests, a fully charged battery can work for more than 10 hours at an output voltage of 8V, and the two batteries can be used for more than 20 hours in total. The battery can be fully charged about 3 hours with the Type-C fast charging cable. And the battery is equipped with a 10V jumpstart start function, even big mags can be pushed.

Hertz & Volts: The ambition vibe machine displays your machine speed in both Hertz & Volts. When you adjust the volt, the hertz will be changed too. products.name: Ambition Vibe Tattoo Machine Brushless Motor
products.description:
Once you go wireless, you will love Ambition tattoo machine equipment. Experience the freedom of going wireless by turning your favorite tattoo machine into a wireless machine.

Material: space aluminum alloy

Needle Stroke: 4.0mm

Motor: brushless motor, not only long lifespan,Durable motor Precise parts and professional design Brings longevity and quiet running

A direct drive tattoo machine pen that offers 4 mm stroke, the tattoo machine excels in lining, shading and colour packing, and is also very quiet to run and creates more lower vibration.

Motor Speed: 12V - 10000RPM

Power Supply: 4.5-12 Volts; 73-195 Hertz

The ambition vibe machine displays your machine speed in both Hertz & Volts. When you adjust the volt, the hertz will be changed too. Hertz allows you to know the current speed of your machine more precisely.

Single Battery Capacity: 2400mAh (4800mAh for 2 batteries)

Charging time: about 3 hours

One battery operation time: More than 10 hours (20 hours for 2 batteries)

Output Voltage : 4.5V-12V, stitch frequency:73 -195 Hz

LED display content: output voltage range + working time + battery usage+Hertz+Ampere

Instructions for use:

- Power ON/OFF: Touch "O" key for 3 seconds

- Output pause / resume: Touch "O" key to pause the output, and touch it again to resume the output(the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).

- Adjust output voltage: Touch the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. The voltage can be adjusted through button (+) and (-) respectively with the voltage of 0.1V on each touch.

Tattoo Power Supply: The LED display will show the remaining power percentage. Fast charging through the matching fast-charging Type-c data cable can usually be fully charged about 3 hours.

Notice: The touch button will be more sensitive than the ordinary button, try to avoid touching the switch button when changing the needle or adjust the needle length so you will not get hurt.
products.short_description:
Machine Size: The ambition vibe machine is the same size as the soldier machine, 145mm in length and 32mm in diameter. We upgraded the material and made it with high hardness aluminum alloy material, which reduced the weight of this vibe tattoo pen to 185g. At the same time, the weight balance is further improved, making it easier for tattoo artists to tattoo for a long time.

Battery Buttons: The battery of the vibe tattoo machine adopts high-sensitivity touch buttons, which changes the button method of the traditional wireless battery pen. It only needs to gently place your finger on the button. High-sensitivity touch buttons can be used even if you wear tattoo gloves or the machine is covered with a machine cover bag.

Battery Display:The vibe cordless gun machine adopts LED digital display screen, which is equipped with various machine data. It displays the machine's working voltage, current, remaining power, Hertz and timer. These data can help tattoo artists to clearly know the working status of the machine and meet daily tattooing needs.

Battery Capacity: The real capacity of the vibe battery is 2400 mAh. After many tests, a fully charged battery can work for more than 10 hours at an output voltage of 8V, and the two batteries can be used for more than 20 hours in total. The battery can be fully charged about 3 hours with the Type-C fast charging cable. And the battery is equipped with a 10V jumpstart start function, even big mags can be pushed.

Hertz & Volts: The ambition vibe machine displays your machine speed in both Hertz & Volts. When you adjust the volt, the hertz will be changed too. Hertz allows you to know the current speed of your machine more precisely. The working voltage of the vibe machine is 4.5V-12V, the frequency of 4.5V working voltage is about 72 Hz, and the frequency of 12V is about 196 Hz. Its frequency will change with voltage regulation, adjust power by 0.1.

Machine Motor: The vibe wireless tattoo machine built-in a brushless motor and 4.0mm stainless steel stroke cam. The brushless motor greatly prolongs the service life of the machine, and is more powerful and quieter than the coreless motor. The 4.0 stainless steel stroke cam is not easy to wear and deform, it makes the machine have good balance between lines and shading, and perfect for demanding lining and color packing.

Widely applications: The pen machine is compatible with all major brands tattoo cartridge needles, and the direct drive system makes tattoo machine get stronger and better for liner and shader.

Package Include: 1 X wirelss tattoo machine, (1X extra battery), 1X RCA adapter, 1X extra 3.5mm stroke cam for free, 1X Type-C fast charging cord,1X zipper box.

After-sales Service: If you are not satisfied with the machine within a month, you could contact Amazon for a return or exchange. The ambition vibe machine comes with a 12-month warranty, please feel free to contact us if you have any problems about this machine. We will try our best to serve you.

products.name: Ambition G4 RCA Wireless Tattoo Power Supply
products.description:
Tattoo Power Supply - Ambition G4 Professional Portable RCA Wireless Tattoo 1950mAh Lithium Battery Supply with LCD Digital Display for Rotary Tattoo Pen Machine Gun

Material : space aluminium alloy + high quality insulating plastic

Connector : RCA Charging time : 2 hours

Operation time : After fully charged, this battery can work continuously for 6-8 hours, or even longer. It depends on personal usage and tattoo machine.

Output fixed current : 2A Working voltage : 3.7V Charging voltage : DC 5V±0.5V 1000mAh

Output voltage : 5-12V

Adjustment interval : ±0.5V

LCD display content : output voltage range + battery usage + timer

Instructions for use:

- Power ON/OFF: Long press "O" key for 3 seconds

- Output pause / resume: Short press "O" key to pause the output, and short press it again to resume the output(the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).

- Adjust output voltage: Press the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. The voltage can be adjusted through button (+) and (-) respectively with the voltage of 0.5V on each press.

- Working time: The working time can be accurate to minutes. When the power is turned off, the time will be cleared. When the output is paused, it will also stop counting.

Power: The LCD display will show the remaining power, and the full power will display 4 divisions. Fast charging through the matching fast-charging USB data cable can usually be fully charged in 1.5-2 hours.

Please pay attention to the change of power at any time to prevent sudden power loss from affecting your tattooing work.

Once you go wireless, you will love Ambition tattoo machine equipment. Experience the freedom of going wireless by turning your favorite tattoo machine into a wireless machine.
Material: space aluminum alloy
6Needle Strokes: 2.2mm, 2.6mm, 3.0mm, 3.4mm, 3.8mm, 4.2mm.
Motor: Coreless Motor.
Motor Speed: 10V - 9000RPM
Single Battery Capacity: 1800mAh
Charging time: about2 hours
Operation time: about 6 hours
Output Voltage : 5V-12V
LCD display content: output voltage range + battery usage+working time
Instructions for use:
- Power ON/OFF: Long press "O" key for 3 seconds
- Output pause / resume: Short press "O" key to pause the output, and short press it again to resume the output(the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).
- Adjust output voltage: Press the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. The voltage can be adjusted through button (+) and (-) respectively with the voltage of 0.1V on each press.
Tattoo Power Supply: The LED display will show the remaining power, and the full power will display 4 divisions. Fast charging through the matching charging cable can usually be fully charged about 2 hours.

Package Included：


Single Battery: Ambition rotary battery tattoo pen machine includes 1pc Battery Tattoo Pen, 1pc RCA adapter, 1pc charging cable, 1pc Box.

Dual Battery：Ambition rotary battery tattoo pen machine includes 1pc Battery Tattoo Pen, 1pc extra battery, 1pc RCA adapter, 1pc charging cable, 1pc Box.
products.short_description:
• Material: Ambition rotary battery tattoo pen machine made of aluminium alloy frame and CNC carved. Length:137mm/5.39inches, diameter: 32mm/1.25inches, weight:217g/7.65oz. Detachable as a whole, easy to disassemble, maintain and replace spare parts.
  • 6 Adjustable Strokes: This tattoo machine support 2.2mm, 2.6mm, 3.0mm,3.4mm,3.8mm and 4.2mm stroke length, change the stroke on the fly just by turning the adjustment knob, great for applying soft black and grey,packing colour and blending and lining. The pen machine is compatible with most cartridge needles types.
  • About Motor: Ambition rotary battery tattoo pen machine built-in coreless motor, 12V - 10500RPM. More powerful, low skin loss, fast coloring, no hot for long time working. Eccentric wheel system make tattoo machine get stronger and better for liner and shader.Built-in stainless steel high-grade positioning steel ball to adjust the needle position with , adjust the gear position accurately.
  • About Battery: Battery Capacity is 1800mAh, can support long-term tattoo work, output stable. 8V output voltage can work for 6 hours, only need 1.5-2 hours to fully charge. The side of the battery has a visible LCD display, which can clearly display the working time,voltage and remaining power. Short press the voltage adjustment buttons, the adjustment interval is ±0.1V,working voltage is 5-12V.

products.name: Ambition Vibe Kit-Black
products.description:
Once you go wireless, you will love Ambition tattoo machine equipment. Experience the freedom of going wireless by turning your favorite tattoo machine into a wireless machine.
Material: space aluminum alloy
Needle Stroke: 4.0mm
Motor: brushless motor, not only long lifespan,Durable motor Precise parts and professional design Brings longevity and quiet running
A direct drive tattoo machine pen that offers 4 mm stroke, the tattoo machine excels in lining, shading and colour packing, and is also very quiet to run and creates more lower vibration.
Motor Speed: 12V - 10000RPM
Power Supply: 4.5-12 Volts; 73-195 Hertz
The ambition vibe machine displays your machine speed in both Hertz & Volts. When you adjust the volt, the hertz will be changed too. Hertz allows you to know the current speed of your machine more precisely.
Single Battery Capacity: 2400mAh (4800mAh for 2 batteries)
Charging time: about 3 hours
One battery operation time: More than 7 hours (14 hours for 2 batteries)
Output Voltage : 4.5V-12V, stitch frequency:73 -195 Hz
LED display content: output voltage range + working time + battery usage+Hertz+Ampere
Instructions for use:
- Power ON/OFF: Touch "O" key for 3 seconds
- Output pause / resume: Touch "O" key to pause the output, and touch it again to resume the output(the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).
- Adjust output voltage: Touch the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. The voltage can be adjusted through button (+) and (-) respectively with the voltage of 0.1V on each touch.
Tattoo Power Supply: The LED display will show the remaining power percentage. Fast charging through the matching fast-charging cable can usually be fully charged about 3 hours.
Notice: The touch button will be more sensitive than the ordinary button, try to avoid touching the switch button when changing the needle or adjust the needle length so you will not get hurt.
products.short_description:
• Package Included: Ambition tattoo kit complete includes 1pc wireless tattoo machine(4.0 stroke cam inside), 1pc extra battery, 1pc power cable,1pc RCA adapter,1pc extra 3.5mm stroke cam,1pc zipper box, 1pc silicone RCA cord,100pcs tattoo cartridge needle(20X1203RL,20X1205RL,20X1207RL,20X1207RM,20X1209RM),1 pc tattoo pen holder, 2pcs bandage,one roll tattoo film, 20pcs needle cover,2 pair of gloves,20pcs pen bag,1pc big case.
  • 100Pcs Tattoo Cartridge: Ambition premium tattoo cartridges needle are made of 316 medical stainless steel. Each needle is screened and tested strictly, come with safety membrane to stop ink leakage to the tube or machine,individually packaged.
  • Machine Size: The ambition vibe machine is the same size as the soldier machine, 145mm in length and 32mm in diameter. We upgraded the material and made it with high hardness aluminum alloy material, which reduced the weight of this vibe tattoo pen to 185g. At the same time, the weight balance is further improved, making it easier for tattoo artists to tattoo for a long time. Note: When the first time use, fully drain the battery and use it with a full charge.
  • Machine Motor: The vibe wireless tattoo machine built-in a brushless motor and 4.0mm stainless steel stroke cam. The brushless motor greatly prolongs the service life of the machine, and is more powerful and quieter than the coreless motor. The 4.0 stainless steel stroke cam is not easy to wear and deform, it makes the machine have good balance between lines and shading, and perfect for demanding lining and color packing.
  • Upgrade Touch Button&Big Battery Capacity: The battery of the vibe tattoo machine adopts high-sensitivity touch buttons more convenient to operate. The screen displays the machine's working voltage, current, remaining power, Hertz and timer. Battery capacity is 2400 mAh, can work for more than 7 hours at an output voltage of 8V, and the two batteries can be used for more than 14 hours in total, equipped with a 10V jumpstart start function, even big mags can be pushed.

products.short_description:
• Ambition TREX tattoo cartridges are made of 316 medical stainless steel. The needle tip uses an A-stage needle. Each needle is screened and tested strictly. Exact fit for needle groups every time, smooth edges eliminate additional trauma.
  • Ambition TREX green tattoo cartridges needles have been providing with high density clear plastic body. The shells are made of medical plastic, easy tattooing and better visibility. Low profile housing & better ink flow & shaped on the inside.
  • The TREX tattoo needles come with safety membrane to prevent ink leakage to the tube or machine. It can prevent ink spitback. The membranes and tips of these needles allow artists to enjoy a more fluid tattooing procedure.
  • These cartridges needles are E.O. sterilized and packaged in blister pack. Each cartridge is individually packaged. Compatible with all standard cartridge grips & machines.
  • Package include: 1 boxes cartridges needles.20pcs per box.

products.name: Claws-Black-Single Battery
products.description:
Xnet is a professional tattoo supplies manufacturer, we focus on the quality of the tattoo machine and the actual good operating experience, provide high quality service and product for the tattoo artist.
Feature:
Motor:Brushless Motor
Stroke: 5.0mm
Color:Silver/Black
Operating Voltage: 5V-12V
Battery capacity: 1800 mAh
Battery working time: 6-7 hours
Charging time: About 2 hours
Battery interface: type-C
LED Display Content: Output voltage range + battery usage+working time
Instructions for use:
Power ON/OFF: Long press "O" key for 3 seconds
Output pause / resume: Short press "O" key to pause the output, and short press it again to resume the output(the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause.
Adjust output voltage: Press the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. The voltage can be adjusted through button (+) and (-) respectively with the voltage of 0.1V on each press. When you long press the voltage adjustment buttons, the voltage will change by 0.5V each time.
products.short_description:
• Product parameters: Xnet Claws wireless tattoo machine made of aluminum alloy by precision Technology, easy to disassemble, easy to maintain and replace parts. Wireless rotary machine single pen weight is 164.5g/0.36lb, length: 131mm/5.16inches, grip part diameter: 32mm/1.26inches.The tattoo machine is lightweight and easy to carry.
  • Easy to Use: Built-in stainless steel high-grade positioning steel ball, the sound is clear, adjust the needle accurately. Flexible and lightweight for every style, Gently and smoothly transfers ink to skin, Suitable for all skin types.

Material: Aluminium alloy and high quality insulating plastic.

Interface: RCA interface

Battery Capacity: Long battery: 2400mAh Short battery: 1650mAh

Charging Time: About 2 hours

Operation Time: Under normal 8V voltage, the long battery voltage stable state can last for more than 7 hours,the short battery voltage stable state can last for more than 3 hours,long time working the voltage is stable

Output Fixed Current：2A

Working Voltage: 3.7V

Charging Voltage: DC 5V±0.5V 1000mAh

Output Voltage: 5-12V

LED Display Content: Output voltage range + battery usage

Instructions for Use:

Power ON/OFF: Long press "O" key for 3 seconds

Output Pause / Resume: Short press "O" key to pause the output, and short press it again to resume the output (the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).

Adjust Output Voltage: Press the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. LED display shows 5-12V, each adjustment ±0.1V, when you long press the voltage adjustment buttons, the voltage will change by 0.5V each time.

Power: The LED display will show the remaining power, and the full power will display 4 divisions. Fast charging through the matching fast-charging USB data cable can usually be fully charged about 2 hours. Please pay attention to the change of power at any time to prevent sudden power loss from affecting your tattooing work.
products.short_description:
• Material: Xnet G5 Tattoo Power Pack Supply made of aluminium alloy frame and high quality insulating plastic.Mini portable, light weight, easy to carry so that you can do tattoo work outdoors.
  • High-quality lithium battery: The Wireless Tattoo Battery Supply built-in 3x 800mAh lithium batteries, the working voltage is 3.7V, output current is 2A. Fast charging, can be full state in 2 hours.
  • The wireless tattoo power bank can last up to 7 hours working time depending on personal usage and the tattoo machine, and long time working the voltage is stable. Notice: Please fully charge before each use.
  • The voltage adjustment range of this G4 battery is 5-12V, which can be adjusted by ±0.1V each time. The battery screen has the functions of displaying output voltage, remaining power.
  • The interface of this power supply is a standard RCA interface. Fits for all standard RCA connection rotary pen tattoo machines, liner and shaders. Package include:1x Wireless tattoo power, 1x USB tattoo power cable.

products.name: Ambition 2 in 1 Tattoo Battery Grip
products.description:
Tattoo battery grip - One-hand control switch voltage regulation, replace traditional power supply/foot pedal/handle/plug cord
Dimensions: 86.5mm*34mm
Output interface: RCA interface
Built-in stainless steel high-grade positioning steel ball to adjust the needle length more accurately
Instructions for use
This device is a wireless battery handle and needs to be used with the machine. It comes with an RCA cable. The specific functions are as follows: 1. Long press the black "O" button on the battery for 3-5 seconds to turn on, and then long press for 3-5 seconds to turn off;
2. Pause: During normal work, short press the black "O" key to pause the work, and then short press again to resume the working state;
3. Adjust the voltage: Adjust the voltage range by touching the up and down keys " +" or "-" position, short press once to adjust to 0.1V;
4. Strong Power: 1600mAh capacity, 8V battery life can last for more than 5 hours, stable power output; The output current is fixed at 2A. The lithium battery releases the stored electricity through the activation of the switch key, and then outputs it from the RCA interface to start the machine and drive the handle. Output voltage range: (4-12V);
5. Charging: The charging port is equipped with a type-c interface, which makes charging more stable and secure. It can be fully charged in 1.5 hours;
6. Starting voltage: memory function, restore the last closed voltage after starting.
products.short_description:
• Material: Ambition wireless tattoo machine grip made of aluminum alloy. Length: 86.5mm/3.4inches,Diameter: 34mm/1.33inches.Net weight:93g/3.28oz. Lightweight appearance, with power supply, makes tattoos easy and more convenient.
  • High Quality Lithium Battery: The tattoo battery cartridge grip built-in high quality lithium batteries, the tattoo grip battery capacity is 1600mAh, output voltage is 4-12V, output current is 2A. Built-in 8V jump start function. It can work continuously for 5 hours after 2 hours fully charged. Cartridge tattoo grips suitable for most tattoo needles, work great for motor machine.
  • One-hand control switch voltage regulation,work more comfortably. Replace traditional power supply/foot pedal/handle/plug cord. Realize the one-hand control switch voltage regulation, no need to worry about the inability to pause ink splashing when sticking color materials. Non-slip design, which will not be tired after long-term use or sweating. The interface of this tattoo power tube grip is a standard RCA interface. Fits for all standard RCA connection motor machine.
  • The side of the battery tube grip has a visible LCD display, which can clearly display the working voltage, remaining power and working time. Adjust the voltage range by touching the up and down keys " +" or "-" position, press once to adjust to 0.1V. Built-in stainless steel high-grade positioning steel ball to adjust the needle length more accurately.
  • Products Include: Wireless handle *1, stainless steel needle plunger bar *3 (85-90-95mm), charging cable*1, box*1.

Output fixed current：2A

Working voltage: 3.7V

Output Voltage : 5V-12V

LED display content: output voltage range + battery usage + working time

Instructions for use:

- Power ON/OFF: Long press "O" key for 3 seconds

- Output pause / resume: Short press "O" key to pause the output, and short press it again to resume the output(the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).

- Adjust output voltage: Press the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. The voltage can be adjusted through button (+) and (-) respectively with the voltage of 0.5V on each press.

- Working time: The working time can be accurate to minutes. When the power is turned off, the time will be cleared. When the output is paused, it will also stop counting.

Power: The LED display will show the remaining power, and the full power will display 4 divisions. Fast charging through the matching fast-charging USB data cable can usually be fully charged in 1.5-2 hours.

Please pay attention to the change of power at any time to prevent sudden power loss from affecting your tattooing work.

Tips: Our products are 100% brand new. There is a protective film on the screen. There may be a small amount of scratches during the production, packaging and transportation. Just tear off the protective film after receiving the product.

2400mAh Large Battery Capacity

 

  1. The real capacity of the vibe battery is 2400 mAh. After many tests, a fully charged battery can work for more than 7 hours at an output voltage of 8V, and the two batteries can be used for more than 14 hours in total.
  2. The battery can be fully charged about 3 hours with the Type-C fast charging cable. And the battery is equipped with a 10V jumpstart start function, even big mags can be pushed.

    High-sensitivity Touch Buttons

     

    1. The battery of the vibe tattoo machine adopts high-sensitivity touch buttons, which changes the button method of the traditional wireless battery pen. It only needs to gently place your finger on the button.
    2. High-sensitivity touch buttons can be used even if you wear tattoo gloves or the machine is covered with a machine cover bag.

      Multifunction LED Display

       

      1. The vibe cordless gun machine adopts LED digital display screen, which is equipped with various machine data. It displays the machine's working voltage, current, remaining power, Hertz and timer. These data can help tattoo artists to clearly know the working status of the machine and meet daily tattooing needs.
      2. The ambition vibe machine displays your machine speed in both Hertz & Volts. When you adjust the volt, the hertz will be changed too. Hertz allows you to know the current speed of your machine more precisely. The working voltage of the vibe machine is 4.5V-12V, the frequency of 4.5V working voltage is about 72 Hz, and the frequency of 12V is about 196 Hz. Its frequency will change with voltage regulation, adjust power by 0.1.

Ambition is a professional tattoo supplies manufacturer, we focus on the quality of the tattoo machine and the actual good operating experience, provide high quality service and product for the tattoo artist.
About Tattoo Pen:
Condition: Hundred percent new
Material: Aluminium alloy
Size:Length:86mm/3.38inches,diameter:36mm/1.41inches
Tattoo Pen Net Weight:130g/4.58oz
Custom brushless motor speed:12V / 10000RPM
About Tattoo Power Supply:
Material : aluminium alloy+high quality insulating plastic+silicone keys.
Connector :RCA
Battery Capacity: 2400mAh
Charging time : About 3 hours
Operation time : Under normal 8V voltage, the voltage stable state can last for 10 hours,long time working the voltage is stable.
Output voltage : 4-12V, ±0.1V
LED display content:output voltage range + battery usage+working time
Instructions for use:
Power ON/OFF: Long press "O" key for 3 seconds
Output pause / resume: Short press "O" key to pause the output, and short press it again to resume the output (the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).
Adjust output voltage: Press the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage.
12V jumpstart function,double-click the power button to turn on(J)/turn off(S) the jumpstart.

 

Package Include:

Kit 1：1 X tattoo machine, 1X tattoo power supply, 1X extra 4.5mm stroke cam , 1X extra 5.0mm stroke cam , 1X RCA clip cord, 1X charging cable, 1X zipper box.

Kit 2：1 X tattoo machine, 1X long tattoo power supply, 1X short tattoo power supply,1X extra 4.5mm stroke cam , 1X extra 5.0mm stroke cam , 1X RCA clip cord, 1X charging cable, 1X zipper box.
products.short_description:
• Size: Ambition short tattoo pen made of aluminium alloy frame and CNC carved. Total Length:140mm/5.51inches,diameter:36mm/1.41inches, total weight:200g/7.05oz. Short and portable,lighter and it has minimal vibration,give the tattooist better control and less fatigue. Ambition Tattoo Power Supply made of aluminium alloy frame and high quality acrylic, the size is small, light weight, easy to carry so that you can do tattoo work outdoors.
  • Brushless Motor: The tattoo machine powered by custom brushless motor and 4.0mm stainless steel stroke cam. The brushless motor greatly prolongs the service life of the machine, and is more powerful and quieter than the coreless motor.Motor Speed 12V 10000RPM,working Voltage 3.7V. The 4.0 stainless steel stroke cam is not easy to wear and deform, it makes the machine have good balance between lines and shading, and perfect for demanding lining and color packing.
  • Ergonomic Design: this tattoo pen combined with the lightweight body and low center of gravity, you'll be sure to have a firm graspon your machine. Non-slip design on the grip support long working, effortless and comfort. adopts steel ball rotation adjustment structure to adjust the needle more accurately. The tattoo pen machine is compatible with all major brands tattoo cartridge needles, and the direct drive system makes tattoo machine get stronger and better for liner and shader.
  • Long-lasting Power Pack: The wireless tattoo power supply capacity is 2400mAh, the working voltage is 4-12V, the adjustment is ±0.1V. Support 10 hours working time under normal 8V voltage.The LED screen displays the working voltage, working time and remaining power. Support jumpstart function,double-click the power button to turn on(J)/turn off(S) the jumpstart, support your machine to defeat the stiffest of cartridge needle membranes.Compatible with most RCA tattoo machines.

products.name: Xnet Bestia Adjustable Stroke Wireless Tattoo Machine Pen
products.description:
Xnet Tattoo Equipment Supply

Xnet Bestia Ajustable Stroke Wireless Tattoo Machine

ABOUT XNET:

XNET is a company that focuses on tattoo equipment supplies. We aim to allow tattoo artists to find a tattoo machine that suits them well and can do more amazing works for clients. We are truly grateful for those who supports us, we are still growing and believe tomorrow will be better!

 

More Details of Bestia Rotary Cartridge Tattoo Pen

2400mAh Battery with Color Screen

Xnet tattoo gun can display remaining power, timer, voltage and herz. 2400 mAh battery, takes 2-3 hours to fully charge, can last for 8-10 hours. Importantly, double-click the power button to switch between two modes, the blue one is the standard mode, and the green one is the 8V strong start mode.

Adjustable Stroke Tattoo Pen

products.name: AB-Vibe3ZC-Black-Single Battery
products.description:
Once you go wireless, you will love Ambition tattoo machine equipment. Experience the freedom of going wireless by turning your favorite tattoo machine into a wireless machine.
Material: space aluminum alloy
Needle Stroke: 2.5mm/3.5mm/4.0mm/4.5mm
Motor: Total 4 brushless motors, not only long lifespan,Durable motor Precise parts and professional design Brings longevity and quiet running
A direct drive tattoo machine pen that offers 4 stroke cams, support multiple tattoo styles.
Motor Speed: 12V - 10000RPM
Power Supply: 4.5-12 Volts; 73-195 Hertz
The ambition vibe machine displays your machine speed in both Hertz & Volts. When you adjust the volt, the hertz will be changed too. Hertz allows you to know the current speed of your machine more precisely.
Single Battery Capacity: 2400mAh (4800mAh for 2 batteries)
Charging time: about 3 hours
One battery operation time: More than 7 hours (14 hours for 2 batteries)
Output Voltage : 4.5V-12V, stitch frequency:73 -195 Hz
LED display content: output voltage range + working time + battery usage+Hertz+Ampere
Instructions for use:
- Power ON/OFF: Touch "O" key for 3 seconds
- Output pause / resume: Touch "O" key to pause the output, and touch it again to resume the output(the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).
- Adjust output voltage: Touch the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. The voltage can be adjusted through button (+) and (-) respectively with the voltage of 0.1V on each touch.
Automatically lock the display in 3 minutes, press and hold the power button to unlock.
Tattoo Power Supply: The LED display will show the remaining power percentage. Fast charging through the matching fast-charging cable can usually be fully charged about 3 hours.
Notice: The touch button will be more sensitive than the ordinary button, try to avoid touching the switch button when changing the needle or adjust the needle length.

 

Package Include:
Single Battery：1 X wirelss tattoo machine, 1X RCA adapter, 1 X extra 2.5mm stroke cam with motor ,1 X extra 3.5mm stroke cam with motor, 1 X extra 3.5mm stroke cam(No motor), 1 X extra 4.5mm stroke cam with motor,1X fast charging cord,1X RCA clip cord,2X Disposable sponge grip cover,20pcs pen bag,1X suitcase.

Dual Battery：1 X wirelss tattoo machine, 1X extra battery, 1X RCA adapter, 1 X extra 2.5mm stroke cam with motor ,1 X extra 3.5mm stroke cam with motor, 1 X extra 3.5mm stroke cam(No motor), 1 X extra 4.5mm stroke cam with motor,1X fast charging cord,1X RCA clip cord,2X Disposable sponge grip cover,20pcs pen bag,1X suitcase.
products.short_description:
• Machine Size: The ambition vibe machine is the same size as the soldier machine, 145mm in length and 32mm in diameter. We upgraded the material and made it with high hardness aluminum alloy material, which reduced the weight of this vibe tattoo pen to 185g. At the same time, the weight balance is further improved, making it easier for tattoo artists to tattoo for a long time. Note: When the first time use, fully drain the battery and use it with a full charge.
  • About Battery : The battery of the vibe tattoo machine adopts high-sensitivity touch buttons easy to operate. The screen displays working voltage, current, remaining power, Hertz and timer. Battery capacity is 2400 mAh, can work for more than 7 hours at an output voltage of 8V, and the two batteries support 14 hours in total, equipped with a jumpstart start function, even big mags can be pushed. Automatically lock the display in 3 minutes, press and hold the power button to unlock.
  • 4 Machine Motors: The vibe wireless tattoo machine built-in a brushless motor and 4.0mm stainless steel stroke cam. The brushless motor greatly prolongs the service life of the machine, and is more powerful and quieter than the coreless motor. Comes with extra 3 motors and extra 2.5mm, 3.5mm, 4.5mm stroke cam, the stainless steel stroke cam is not easy to wear and deform, support multiple tattoo styles such as great for applying soft black and grey,packing colour and blending and lining.
  • Widely Applications: The pen machine is compatible with all major brands tattoo cartridge needles, and the direct drive system makes tattoo machine get stronger and better for liner and shader.

products.name: AB-Vibeszp-2.5mm Stroke Red-Single Battery
products.description:
Once you go wireless, you will love Ambition tattoo machine equipment. Experience the freedom of going wireless by turning your favorite tattoo machine into a wireless machine.
Material: space aluminum alloy
Needle Stroke: 2.5mm&3.5mm

A direct drive tattoo machine pen that offers 2.5 mm stroke, the tattoo machine excels in lining, shading and colour packing, and is also very quiet to run and creates more lower vibration.
Motor Speed: 12V - 10000RPM
Power Supply: 4.5-12 Volts; 73-195 Hertz

Single Battery Capacity: 1800mAh (3600mAh for 2 batteries)
Charging time: about 1.5-2 hours
One battery operation time: More than 6 hours (12 hours for 2 batteries)
Output Voltage : 4.5V-12V, stitch frequency:73 -195 Hz
LED display content: output voltage range + working time + battery usage+Hertz+Jumpstart function
Instructions for use:
- Power ON/OFF: Long press "O" key for 3 seconds
- Output pause / resume: Short press "O" key to pause the output, and short press it again to resume the output(the resume voltage is the working voltage before the pause).
- Adjust output voltage: Press the "+" or"-" key to adjust output voltage. The voltage can be adjusted through button (+) and (-) respectively with the voltage of 0.1V on each press.
Tattoo Power Supply: The LED display will show the remaining power, and the full power will display 4 divisions. Fast charging through the matching charging cable can usually be fully charged about 2 hours.

 

Single Battery Package Include: 1 X wirelss tattoo machine,1X RCA adapter, 1X extra 3.5mm stroke cam, 1X fast charging cord,1X zipper box. The ambition vibe machine comes with a 12-month warranty.

Dual Battery Package Include: 1 X wirelss tattoo machine, 1X extra battery,1X RCA adapter, 1X extra 3.5mm stroke cam, 1X fast charging cord,1X zipper box. The ambition vibe machine comes with a 12-month warranty.
products.short_description:
• Machine Size: We upgraded the material and made it with high hardness aluminum alloy material, which reduced the weight of this vibe tattoo pen to 165g. 129mm in length and 32mm in diameter. The weight balance is further improved, making it easier for tattoo artists to tattoo for a long time. Note: When the first time use, fully drain the battery and use it with a full charge.
  • About Battery: One battery capacity is 1800mAh, can support long-term tattoo work, output stable. 8V output voltage can work for 6 hours, only need 1.5-2 hours to fully charge. The side of the battery has a visible LCD display, which can clearly display the working voltage, remaining power, Hertz and timer, equipped with a jumpstart start function, even big mags can be pushed. Short press the voltage adjustment buttons, the adjustment interval is ±0.1V,working voltage is 5-12V.
  • Machine Motor: The vibe wireless tattoo machine built-in a brushless motor and 2.5mm stainless steel stroke cam. The brushless motor greatly prolongs the service life of the machine, and is more powerful and quieter than the coreless motor. The 2.5 stainless steel stroke cam is not easy to wear and deform, it makes the machine have good balance between lines and shading, and perfect for demanding lining and color packing.
  • Widely Applications: The pen machine is compatible with all major brands tattoo cartridge needles, and the direct drive system makes tattoo machine get stronger and better for liner and shader.

products.name: AB-SWKTKIT-Black-Single Battery
products.description:
This pen style tattoo machine is perfect for fine or bold lines, realistic color, new school and old school style. Compatible with major brand cartridge needles. Flexible and lightweight for every style gently and smoothly transfers ink to skin, suitable for all skin types. great for tattoo beginner and artists.

 

Features :

1. This is a tattoo machine with adjustable stroke, 2.2-4.2mm, and the stroke distance you need can be adjusted in the middle of the rotating machine. Can adapt to a variety of styles and a variety of fine patterns

2.LED color touch screen, 2400mAh large capacity, 8-9 hours of work,memory function, more intelligent.

3. The machine uses Coreless motor, fast speed, quiet, strong power, will not wear the motor, so that the machine can ensure more lasting work

4. The classic design of the grip, which can be more comfortable when gripping the finger

5. This machine supports the use of wireless battery and RCA cable connection, whether you are outdoors or indoors can work easily

6. This machine is made by numerical control. Precision and durability. Make sure the machine is running well.

7. It can be used with all major cartridge brands as well as Ambition cartridge system

8. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced tattoo artist, you can put this machine to great use in your work

 

About battery：

Press and hold the Ambition key for more than 10 seconds to restart the battery program

automatically lock，After 2 minutes of machine operation, the screen will automatically lock, and sliding from bottom to top can unlock it

The battery has four voltage modes
